$comment: Delta anchors — machine-readable claims that this skill overrides an upstream rule. Consumed by .github/scripts/upstream-ratification.sh; format in standards/upstream-policy.md, schema in schemas/overrides.schema.json. upstream_paths are directory prefixes in the upstream repo; tripwires are literal strings grepped in diff hunks — any variant hitting makes the verdict CONFLICT.

overrides.gforce_rule: WITH USER_MODE — enforces CRUD and sharing as well as FLS
overrides.reason: USER_MODE supersedes SECURITY_ENFORCED: it enforces sharing and CRUD, not only FLS
overrides.delta: SKILL.md hard stops: WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED banned in new code

overrides.gforce_rule: Logger.* (NebulaLogger) — System.debug banned everywhere, tests included
overrides.reason: NebulaLogger gives persisted, level-controlled logging; System.debug is invisible in production
